articles.title: ‘The Social Reckoning’ Flops With $5.5 Million Debut, ‘Other Mommy’ Tops Box Office With $27.5 Million - Variety
articles.description: "Other Mommy" ruled over the North American box office while "The Social Reckoning" crumbled in sixth place.
articles.content: “Other Mommy,” a horror movie starring Jessica Chastain as a double-jointed doppelgänger from hell, scared up $27.5 million in its box office debut. Those ticket sales were enough to lead in North Am… [+7045 chars]
